description: Sends one push to every device of one app user (by `user_id` or `email`) through the Expo push service. Answers devices, sent, failed and pruned (dead tokens removed). Scope: functions:write.

email.description: The app user's email, instead of user_id

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project created or used last in this session, or the only one.

name: push.send_test
title: Send a test push
